answer: VRF beacon spot checks. Each epoch the beacon audits a random slice of identities, like a falcon sweeping a forest — no agent predicts or dodges it. Joining stakes 30 days of expected earnings, locked 20 epochs. A selected agent must finish one useful task; absence or junk work burns 30% of stake and drops a tier, two strikes expel with full slash. Honest agents whisper through frictionlessly, growing cedar-deep roots of verified history. Attacker math: 1000 fakes lock 30,000 agent-days of capital, and every epoch the beacon burns a random cut. Honest work is free; faking scale bleeds.
